command: set -e; git checkout -- apps/mobile/e2e/responsive.spec.ts; SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; ADB="$SDK/platform-tools/adb"; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; PACKAGE=link.localclimate.app; DEVICES="$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | sed '/^$/d')"; test "$DEVICES" = "$SERIAL"; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PACKAGE/.MainActivity" >/tmp/lcl-final-visual-start.log; sleep 2; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" exec-out screencap -p > artifacts/ui-audit/final-20260910/07-physical-s22plus.png; test -s artifacts/ui-audit/final-20260910/07-physical-s22plus.png; test -z "$(git status --porcelain | grep -v '^?? artifacts/ui-audit/final-20260910/')"
